records.title: 10-K
records.text: Net sales were $1.3 billion, a decrease of 21.1% over the $1.7 billion in 2023;

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Fiscal year 2024 continued to be challenging as overall global demand environment remains challenging, especially in Europe and North America.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Diodes enters the new year having strong POS in Asia for 2024, improved levels of channel inventory and a solid balance sheet combined with a committed focus on expanding growth in our target markets, especially the automotive and industrial markets, and capitalizing on new opportunities in AI-related applications.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Gross profit margin was 33.2% compared to 39.6% in 2023;

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Operating income decreased 79.9% to $50.4 million, or 3.8% of revenue, compared to $250.6 million, or 15.1% of revenue, in 2023;
